lines.zh: 藤蔓拖在身后，我一步步退着走。
lines.en: Vines trail behind me as I retreat step by step.

lines.zh: 花园的泥土太软，根须替我迈步。
lines.en: The garden soil is soft, so roots take my steps.

lines.zh: 我不靠近你，我只绕着你走。
lines.en: I never come close; I only circle around you.

lines.zh: 每一步都长出三根新刺。
lines.en: Three new thorns sprout with every single step.

lines.zh: 我在花丛间退行，像一阵绿雾。
lines.en: I drift backwards through the flowers like green mist.

lines.zh: 根须缠住脚踝，那是我自己的。
lines.en: Roots snag my ankles, and they are my own.

lines.zh: 花园的路我走了九十个年头。
lines.en: I have walked these garden paths for ninety years.

lines.zh: 别追我，我的步子留着刺。
lines.en: Do not chase me; my footprints keep their thorns.

lines.zh: 我退得越远，咒语越准。
lines.en: The farther I retreat, the truer my spell flies.

lines.zh: 泥土在我脚下翻成一道沟。
lines.en: Soil rolls over beneath me and becomes a furrow.

lines.zh: 藤蔓替我扛着半边身子。
lines.en: Vines carry half my weight as I walk.

lines.zh: 我在花间踱步，等风替我说法。
lines.en: I pace among blossoms, waiting for wind to speak.

lines.zh: 我数着符文，水的一堆，雷的一堆。
lines.en: I count runes: a pile of water, a pile of thunder.

lines.zh: 藤蔓缠上手腕，自己打了个结。
lines.en: The vine wraps my wrist and knots itself.

lines.zh: 花园的露水从我叶尖滴下去。
lines.en: Dew slides off my leaf tips and drops away.

lines.zh: 我不用眼睛看，我用根须听。
lines.en: I do not watch with eyes; roots do the listening.

lines.zh: 四十五颗心的分量，压弯一根枝条。
lines.en: Forty-five hearts of weight bend a single branch.

lines.zh: 风从花海来，带着旧咒的余味。
lines.en: Wind from the flower sea still tastes of old spells.

lines.zh: 我把雷鸣符文摆成一个小圈。
lines.en: I arrange thunder runes into a small ring.

lines.zh: 水符文在掌心自己渗出凉意。
lines.en: Water runes sweat cold into my palm.

lines.zh: 谁动了我南边那排藤架。
lines.en: Someone has disturbed the trellis on my south side.

lines.zh: 我对着空花圃念完一整段咒。
lines.en: I finish a whole incantation at an empty flowerbed.

lines.zh: 泥土里全是我的旧根，吵得很。
lines.en: Old roots fill the soil, and they are noisy.

lines.zh: 今天没有敌人，藤蔓有点闲。
lines.en: No enemy today, so my vines grow restless.

lines.zh: 我摸一摸胸口，那里是木头的。
lines.en: I touch my chest and find only wood inside.

lines.zh: 花园安静得像在等我出错。
lines.en: The garden is quiet, as if waiting for me to slip.

lines.zh: 我把一根藤蔓打了个活结。
lines.en: I tie a vine into a slip knot.

lines.zh: 花园的土是软的，踩下去有声。
lines.en: The garden soil is soft and creaks underfoot.

lines.zh: 雷鸣符文在指尖跳了一下。
lines.en: The thunder rune jumps at my fingertip.

lines.zh: 有只虫爬过我的袍角。
lines.en: A bug crawls over the hem of my robe.

lines.zh: 你踏进我的花圃，鞋底全是泥。
lines.en: You stepped into my flowerbed with muddy boots.

lines.zh: 我认得你身上那股铁味。
lines.en: I know the smell of iron that clings to you.

lines.zh: 站远些，我的咒语有射程。
lines.en: Stand back; my curses have a reach of their own.

lines.zh: 你手里那把剑，砍不断藤。
lines.en: That blade in your hand will not cut vine.

lines.zh: 我数你的脚步，你还没察觉。
lines.en: I have counted your steps; you have not noticed yet.

lines.zh: 你的脚步惊动了我的花。
lines.en: Your footsteps have startled my flowers awake.

lines.zh: 别移开视线，我讨厌被忽略。
lines.en: Do not look away; I dislike being overlooked.

lines.zh: 我数过你走来的十二步。
lines.en: I counted the twelve steps that brought you here.

lines.zh: 花园里，生人只有一种用途。
lines.en: In this garden, strangers have exactly one use.

lines.zh: 你的盔甲反光，晃到我的叶。
lines.en: Your armor glints and hurts my leaves.

lines.zh: 我站着不动，不代表我友善。
lines.en: Standing still does not make me friendly.

lines.zh: 再看一眼，我就要念咒了。
lines.en: One more glance and I begin the incantation.

lines.zh: 砍在木头上，震得我手腕发麻。
lines.en: Steel bites wood and numbs my wrist.

lines.zh: 呃，那道口子在渗绿汁。
lines.en: Ah, that cut is leaking green sap.

lines.zh: 我的藤断了一根，还会长。
lines.en: One vine is severed. It will grow back.

lines.zh: 你砍到了我袍子里的旧伤。
lines.en: You struck an old wound under my robe.

lines.zh: 痛，但木头记得住痛。
lines.en: It hurts, but wood remembers pain well.

lines.zh: 退后，我要重新织藤。
lines.en: Back away; I must weave my vines again.

lines.zh: 这不算伤口，算修剪。
lines.en: That is not a wound; it is pruning.

lines.zh: 别砍第二下，我数着的。
lines.en: No second cut; I am keeping count.

lines.zh: 花圃里溅了一片绿。
lines.en: Green splashes across the flowerbed.

lines.zh: 我的根在土里疼得发抖。
lines.en: My roots tremble with pain underground.

lines.zh: 那点腐叶的味道，我确实想要。
lines.en: That smell of rotting leaves, I do want it.

lines.zh: 你把骨粉撒远一点，再远一点。
lines.en: Scatter the bonemeal farther away, then farther still.

lines.zh: 我不靠近，你把东西丢过来。
lines.en: I will not approach; throw the offering to me.

lines.zh: 藤蔓替我伸手，它比我诚实。
lines.en: My vines reach for you, and they are honest.

lines.zh: 花肥？我三百年没吃过这个。
lines.en: Fertilizer? I have not tasted that in three centuries.

lines.zh: 你手里那袋泥土在勾我。
lines.en: That sack of soil in your hand is calling me.

lines.zh: 我只贪一口，就退回去。
lines.en: I will take one mouthful, then retreat again.

lines.zh: 别笑，巫师也会嘴馋。
lines.en: Do not smirk; even wizards get greedy.

lines.zh: 丢在花圃边上，我自己去捡。
lines.en: Drop it at the flowerbed edge; I will fetch it.

lines.zh: 我的根在土里已经伸过去了。
lines.en: My roots are already stretching through the dirt.

lines.zh: 别撞我，我的袍子会缠你。
lines.en: Do not bump me; my robe will tangle you.

lines.zh: 退开，我的藤蔓认生。
lines.en: Back off; my vines are shy with strangers.

lines.zh: 你踩到我的根了，让开。
lines.en: You are standing on my roots. Move aside.

lines.zh: 撞一下，掉三根刺，很划算。
lines.en: One bump costs three thorns. A fair trade.

lines.zh: 我的身体是木头，你会疼。
lines.en: My body is wood, and your shoulder will ache.

lines.zh: 巫师不喜欢被推着走。
lines.en: A wizard does not like being shoved along.

lines.zh: 袍角刮过你，那不算攻击。
lines.en: My hem brushed you; that was not an attack.

lines.zh: 你再挤，我就地生根了。
lines.en: Push once more and I root myself right here.

lines.zh: 花园很宽，你非要走这条。
lines.en: The garden is wide, yet you take this path.

lines.zh: 这一撞，我记在符文上了。
lines.en: I have written this shove into a rune.

lines.zh: 花期到了，藤蔓自己会找伴。
lines.en: My bloom season has come; the vines find company.

lines.zh: 我们不开花，我们只交换孢子。
lines.en: We do not blossom; we trade spores instead.

lines.zh: 两根藤蔓在花架下绕成一圈。
lines.en: Two vines coil into a ring beneath the trellis.

lines.zh: 我把最直的那根枝条留给它。
lines.en: I keep my straightest branch for my partner.

lines.zh: 巫师也有春天，只是带刺。
lines.en: Wizards have a spring too, only thornier.

lines.zh: 我们在地下交换整片根网。
lines.en: Underground, we trade an entire web of roots.

lines.zh: 它开的白花，比我念的咒好看。
lines.en: Its white bloom is prettier than my best spell.

lines.zh: 别靠太近，那是私人的花事。
lines.en: Do not come closer; this flowering is private.

lines.zh: 我们的种子要埋进最深的花圃。
lines.en: Our seeds must go into the deepest flowerbed.

lines.zh: 两根枯枝碰一碰，就算成了。
lines.en: Two dry twigs touch, and that is enough.

lines.zh: 掉在地上的符文，我总要捡。
lines.en: Runes dropped on the ground always come home with me.

lines.zh: 这根藤蔓归我，别抢。
lines.en: This vine is mine. Do not grab it.

lines.zh: 我弯腰需要念一句短咒。
lines.en: Bending down costs me a short spell.

lines.zh: 碎掉的叶子也算材料。
lines.en: Even broken leaves count as material.

lines.zh: 巫师捡东西从不空手。
lines.en: A wizard never picks something up empty-handed.

lines.zh: 这枚雷符文，正好缺两枚。
lines.en: Thunder runes; I was exactly two short.

lines.zh: 我把它塞进藤蔓编的口袋。
lines.en: I tuck it into a pocket woven of vines.

lines.zh: 这枚符文落在我的花圃里。
lines.en: This rune fell inside my flowerbed, so it stays.

lines.zh: 花园的土里总有前人的遗物。
lines.en: Garden soil always hides the last visitor's relics.

lines.zh: 捡一根藤，念一句谢。
lines.en: One vine lifted, one quiet word of thanks.

lines.zh: 你踩坏的花，要用命赔。
lines.en: You crushed my flowers; pay for them with blood.

lines.zh: 找到你了，别往花架后面躲。
lines.en: Found you. Do not hide behind the trellis.

lines.zh: 我的根须告诉我你在左边。
lines.en: My roots say you are on the left.

lines.zh: 距离够了，咒语可以起手。
lines.en: Distance is right; the spell can begin.

lines.zh: 花园里没有无辜的闯入者。
lines.en: No one enters this garden innocent.

lines.zh: 铁与血，两样都瞒不过我。
lines.en: Iron and blood: neither one hides from me.

lines.zh: 我数到三，就开始念。
lines.en: I count to three, then the words start.

lines.zh: 这一片花圃，归我审判。
lines.en: This flowerbed falls under my judgment.

lines.zh: 你的脚步乱了，我听得见。
lines.en: Your steps have gone uneven; I can hear it.

lines.zh: 就是你了，站得最直的那个。
lines.en: You, then; the one standing straightest.

lines.zh: 站在原地，我的咒不追人。
lines.en: Stand still; my spell does not chase.

lines.zh: 藤蔓抬手，替我指着你。
lines.en: A vine lifts and points at you for me.

lines.zh: 我念得很慢，让你听清楚。
lines.en: I speak slowly so you hear every syllable.

lines.zh: 十二点伤害，够不够你退。
lines.en: Twelve points of pain: will that make you leave?

lines.zh: 你在我的射程里画了个圈。
lines.en: You just drew a circle inside my range.

lines.zh: 别跑，跑动更难打中。
lines.en: Do not run; running only makes the aim wander.

lines.zh: 咒语在指尖结成一片叶子。
lines.en: The spell hardens into a leaf on my fingertip.

lines.zh: 我看你胸口的皮甲接缝。
lines.en: I am watching the seam of your leather chestpiece.

lines.zh: 三根藤，一根缠脚，两根指路。
lines.en: Three vines: one for feet, two for aiming.

lines.zh: 花园的规矩，先念咒再说话。
lines.en: Garden rules: incantation first, talk later.

lines.zh: 你贴这么近，我就用藤抽。
lines.en: You came this close, so the vine whips.

lines.zh: 不用咒，木头也够砸你。
lines.en: No spell needed; wood alone will do.

lines.zh: 藤蔓抽在你甲上，像鞭子。
lines.en: Vines crack against your armor like a whip.

lines.zh: 我讨厌近身，所以抽得重。
lines.en: I hate close fights, so I strike hard.

lines.zh: 这一下，把你的剑打歪。
lines.en: This blow knocks your blade off line.

lines.zh: 刺扎进去，你别想拔。
lines.en: The thorn is in; do not try to pull it.

lines.zh: 我退一步，藤再补一下。
lines.en: I step back, and the vine strikes again.

lines.zh: 你砍到的是藤，不是我。
lines.en: What you cut was vine, not me.

lines.zh: 十二点力道，落在你肩上。
lines.en: Twelve points of force land on your shoulder.

lines.zh: 巫师也会用手，只是不常。
lines.en: Wizards use their hands too, just rarely.

lines.zh: 花圃裂开，我从土里站起来。
lines.en: The flowerbed splits and I rise out of it.

lines.zh: 藤蔓先到，我随后就到。
lines.en: The vines arrive first; I follow after.

lines.zh: 花园又多了一个看守。
lines.en: The garden has one more keeper now.

lines.zh: 谁的咒把我从根里叫醒。
lines.en: Whose spell woke me from the roots?

lines.zh: 露水还没干，我已经站好。
lines.en: The dew is still wet, and I am already standing.

lines.zh: 土拨开，我抖掉满身泥。
lines.en: The soil parts; I shake off the dirt.

lines.zh: 九十个年头的睡眠，太短。
lines.en: Ninety years of sleep was far too short.

lines.zh: 花架下多了一双木头的脚。
lines.en: A pair of wooden feet now waits under the trellis.

lines.zh: 我醒来第一件事，是数花。
lines.en: My first act on waking is to count the flowers.

lines.zh: 这片花园需要一个新的声音。
lines.en: This garden needs a new voice in it.

lines.zh: 藤蔓先铺路，我慢慢长出来。
lines.en: Vines lay the path; I grow out slowly.

lines.zh: 我落地时，泥土都安静了。
lines.en: When I land, even the soil goes quiet.

lines.zh: 火！快把这片藤从我身上撕掉。
lines.en: Fire! Tear these vines off me, quickly.

lines.zh: 从花架上摔下来，木头闷响。
lines.en: I fall from the trellis with a wooden thud.

lines.zh: 水灌进木纹里，我沉得很慢。
lines.en: Water soaks into my grain; I sink slowly.

lines.zh: 整片花圃被掀起来，我的根也飞了。
lines.en: The whole flowerbed lifts, roots and all.

lines.zh: 箭钉进藤蔓，卡在那里。
lines.en: The arrow sticks fast in my vines.

lines.zh: 用魔法打我，巫师觉得受辱。
lines.en: Magic against me? A wizard takes offense.

lines.zh: 土里没有养分，我只能慢慢枯。
lines.en: The soil is barren; I wither by degrees.

lines.zh: 雷劈在花园里，符文全响了。
lines.en: Lightning strikes the garden and every rune rings.

lines.zh: 脚下没有土，根须抓不住什么。
lines.en: No soil beneath me; my roots catch nothing.
